evidence.detail: load_disjoint_archetypes uses _arch_disjoint_person_stats table when person_id is provided, so preaggregate_disjoint_archetype_person is in active use
load_matchups uses _matchup_ps_stats table when person_id is provided, so preaggregate_matchups_person is in active use
both functions are called unconditionally in the top-level preaggregate() function

triage.notes: Neither function can be disabled — both tables are queried in production code paths. The remaining open action is to benchmark actual run times and consider optimizations (e.g. ORDER BY NULL per #11176, or index changes), which requires a production database environment.
